title: Account activity reports
description: The format of the two reports. Write out/account_balances.json as an AccountBalancesReport and out/daily_statements.json as a DailyStatementsReport. Running your program twice on the same stream must produce exactly the same files.

Money.description: An amount of money as a string with exactly two decimal places, never negative, e.g. "1234.50" or "0.00".

summary.description: What your program saw. These must add up: messages_received = accounts + transactions_applied + duplicate_messages.

messages_received.description: Every message returned by poll(), including duplicates.

duplicate_messages.description: Messages you identified as duplicates and skipped.

transactions_applied.description: The number of distinct transactions included in the balances.

accounts.description: One row per account, including accounts with no transactions. Sorted by account_id.

owner_name.description: first_name + " " + last_name, or just last_name when first_name is null.

total_deposits.description: The sum of all DEPOSIT amounts.

total_withdrawals.description: The sum of all WITHDRAWAL amounts, as a positive number.

last_transaction_at.description: The timestamp of the most recent transaction, or null if there are none.

statements.description: One statement per account for each UTC date on which that account had at least one transaction. Days with no transactions get no statement. Sorted by account_id, then date.

date.description: The UTC date the transactions happened on (taken from their timestamp).

starting_balance.description: The ending_balance of this account's previous statement, or the account's starting_balance for its first statement.

ending_balance.description: starting_balance + total_deposits - total_withdrawals. Equal to balance_after for the day's last transaction.

transactions.description: That day's transactions in time order. If two have the same timestamp, the lower transaction_id comes first.

amount.description: Always positive; `type` says whether it was added or subtracted.

balance_after.description: The account's balance right after this transaction.
